spans.s:
(ऋ) लेपृ r. 1st cl. (लेपते)
To go, to approach.

Stain, spot, smearing.
5 The wipings of the hand which has offered funeral oblations to three ancestors, and which are considered as an oblation to ancestors in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees.
E.
लिप to smear, &c., aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A bricklayer, a plasterer.
E.
लिप to smear, (Chunam). ण्वुल् aff.

n. (-नं)
Smearing, plastering, anointing.
E.
लिप to smear, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-गी)
An ancestor in the 4th, 5th, and 6th degrees.
E.
लेप, and भागिन् who shares.

m. (-भुक्)
A paternal ancestor of the 4th, 5th, or 6th degree.
E.
लेप, and भुज् who eats.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
Who or what smears, plasters, anoints, &c.
m. (-पी)
A bricklayer, a plasterer.
E.
लेप to plaster, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be spread, as unguent or plaster, to be anointed or plastered.
n. (-प्यं)
Plastering, spreading or smearing ointment, mortar, &c.
E.
लिप to plaster, ण्यत् aff.

m. (-कृत्)
A bricklayer, a plasterer.
E.
लेप्य plastering, and कृत् who makes.

f. (-यी)
A doll, a puppet.
E.
लेप्य plastering, मयट् aff., made of wood with a coat of plaster.

f. (-स्त्री)
A woman, perfumed with fragrant unguents.
E.
लेप्य plastering, and स्त्री a woman.
